symptom: The Forward Evaluation Vault validator used e[e.length] assignment to collect errors. A synthetic inherited Array.prototype index-zero getter/setter can discard the first validation denial, leaving a zero-length error array and admitting a record with an empty required evaluationProtocolId. lesson: Avoiding mutable Array.prototype.push is insufficient when an error sink appends through a fresh array numeric assignment. Inherited setters can erase a validation denial and make invalid research metadata appear valid before hashing or append classification.
guardrail: Create every validation error as an own enumerable array index with Object.defineProperty, not push or e[e.length] assignment.
